import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD2 = 998244353L;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] pos = new ArrayList[10];
    static int cnt = 0;
    static long[] pw = new long[13];
    static long[] s = new long[15];
    static long cnt2;
    static long n;
    static int ans = 0;

    static int query(int fixpre, long val) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
            long offset = (val - (long) fixpre * pw[d]) % MOD2;
            if (offset < 0) offset += MOD2;
            int p = lowerBound(pos[d], MOD2 - offset);
            res = (res + s[d] + offset * (long) pos[d].size() - MOD2 * (long) (pos[d].size() - p)) % MOD;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void dfs(int val, int d) {
        int x = (int) ((cnt - val + MOD2) % MOD2);
        pos[d].add(x);
        cnt++;
        s[d] += x;
        if (d == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) dfs(val * 10 + i, d + 1);
    }

    static void processAll() {
        Deque<Long> st = new ArrayDeque<>();
        st.push(0L);
        while (!st.isEmpty()) {
            long val = st.pop();
            if (val * 1000000L + 999999L <= n && val * 10000000L > n) {
                ans = (int) ((ans + query((int) val, cnt2 + 1)) % MOD);
                cnt2 += cnt;
            } else {
                cnt2++;
                ans = (int) ((ans + ((cnt2 - val) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2) % MOD);
                int start = (val == 0 ? 1 : 0);
                for (int i = 9; i >= start; i--) {
                    long child = val * 10 + i;
                    if (child <= n) st.push(child);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Integer> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) pos[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        dfs(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) Collections.sort(pos[i]);
        pw[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 13; i++) pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 10;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        cnt2 = -1;
        processAll();
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
